role: author-side development/post-job-start measured refinement audit; not prospectively predeclared benchmark acceptance or success requirements
timing_scope: Developed after physical jobs started, with partial progress logs visible; original task D/profile/budgets remain unchanged. Revisions and hashes are retained. No claim these semantic audit rules were declared before the three runs.

threshold_provenance.actuator_position_tolerance_rad: Original H1 sandbox/trusted/relay_scoring.py POSITION_TOLERANCE=0.001; corrects erroneous v7 0.02 allowance, not a relaxation. Earlier results retained.
threshold_provenance.touch_normal_N: run_push.Touch.step uses >1 N filtered contact threshold; reviewer requires current raw force and contact identity at the same threshold to avoid filter residue
threshold_provenance.ground_contact_N: P4 terminal verifier uses foot ground fz >1 N; same contact detection threshold
threshold_provenance.hand_release_net_force_N: P4 physical goal verifier; also requires zero robot-target contact links
threshold_provenance.foot_lift_above_initial_m: existing StepFoot landing tolerance 0.006 m; used to distinguish measured swing from ground-level dragging, not expected 0.05 m lift
threshold_provenance.numeric_position_epsilon_m: numerical resolution only; no nominal stroke percentage chosen from outcomes
threshold_provenance.joint_difference_epsilon_rad: floating point tolerance on necessary delta-q <= frozen velocity limit * dt
threshold_provenance.max_body_collision_N: existing expert-controller collision diagnostic threshold; author reference skill only, not a hand-only public task rule

predicate_definitions.touch: Measured raw both-side contact force projected onto rear normal >1 N with matching contact links at least once each, simultaneous contact at exit, target ground contact and ground-height bound, both feet ground-supported at exit.
predicate_definitions.push: Positive measured target displacement toward declared D, real hand-target contact during transport, target continuously grounded within profile gap, foot support, endpoint target speed <=0.02 m/s as existing Push completion condition. Nominal stroke and contact cap are diagnostics, not hidden goal rules.
predicate_definitions.retreat: No target contact links and low contact force at exit; measured hand-to-box relative displacement retained. Both feet supported at entry/exit.
predicate_definitions.planned_steps: Both feet have measured forward displacement, each has an observed >6 mm rise with unloaded swing foot and supported opposite foot; endpoint has both feet grounded. Entire segment has at least one measured ground-supported foot.
predicate_definitions.return_hands: Exit has released hands and two-foot support. For a middle cycle, subsequent measured Touch in the same continuous run establishes next-contact reachability. For final release preparation, check actual MCP points behind the box rear plane and released supported posture; do not require unused future contact capability. Truncated/unknown continuation remains unknown. Measured command tracking residual remains diagnostic without an invented tolerance.
predicate_definitions.approach: Measured end posture has two-foot support and no hard body collision. Sensor target identification is not established by this privileged expert.
predicate_definitions.clear_hands: Measured upward/backward movement of both hands relative to target and no target contact at exit.
predicate_definitions.stand_up: Measured pelvis rise, end two-foot support and released hands. Whole-body collision/COM margins require separate evidence.
predicate_definitions.hold: Measured base speeds satisfy profile terminal limits and hands remain released; target terminal success separately recomputed by physical goal verifier.
predicate_definitions.settle_release: New v5 route only: hands released, at least one ground-supported foot and target grounded at every sampled state; two-foot exit support. Recompute a continuous final one-second interval of target/root linear <=.03 m/s and angular <=.05 rad/s before Hold. The eight-second timeout is not a success condition. This new route is declared before v5 execution; old v4 evidence is never reclassified.
predicate_definitions.recenter: Planner bookkeeping only; not credited as a separate physical skill. Shared measured boundary recorded, COM recentering not observable in current trace.
predicate_definitions.planned_steps_internal_actions: Split only observed step_label runs. Lift/advance/land/rise/lower get measured displacement and real support/contact checks. transfer/center use measured support load distribution and the next actual swing/lowering as the executed-skill witness; exact controller COM target remains an explicitly non-gating unknown because trace lacks COM. Missing labels remain unknown. Each interval keeps actual shared boundary and issued-command range.
predicate_definitions.joint_continuity: Actual full qpos joint order read from frozen MJCF, finite per-step differences bounded by frozen actuator velocity limits times control_dt; actual actuator summary covers every physics step and stays within declared limits.
predicate_definitions.transitions: Adjacent segments share the exact recorded boundary index/state/qpos; measured base velocity, support and contact topology retained. No arbitrary-start composition claim.
predicate_definitions.terminal_field_provenance: v2 terminal row inherits mcp_meas, mcp_cmd, push_normal and several controller fields from the previous control sample. These are not fresh terminal measurements. Any predicate requiring terminal MCP is unknown; original raw row is retained with field-level provenance. Root/box pose, velocity, support/contact and feet were remeasured.
predicate_definitions.terminal: Independently recompute P4 whole-target-D, release, support, stable dwell and actuator predicates through verify_p4.evaluate; preserve runtime identity verdict separately.

unmeasured_not_certified: continuous contact force between control-rate samples

public_rules.explanation: 5 kg exceeds the declared 2 kg lifted-payload rule. This is a public-rule boundary, not a certificate that the robot cannot physically lift 5 kg. Ground-supported push is the selected legal operation.

budget.token_budget_reason: deterministic privileged expert; no language model called

profile_snapshot.scope: Bounded privileged development reference; no handle variant, no general randomized-policy or sensor-only claim. The task accepts every complete legal route. Full target AABB, ground support, no hand contact and 3 second dwell are scored from measured trace. Initial D exclusion is checked.
profile_snapshot.revision_reason: Use a different legal final action sequence: last Push/Retreat already has measured released ground-supported crouch states. Continue actual bounded joint control at the last reference, settle for measured1s, then hold6s. Skip final reposition/ReturnHands/ClearHands/StandUp. Do not truncate, splice, or reset any old run; all old safety failures remain.
controller_scope_notes: finger_reference_min_rad applies only mirrored index/middle flex/distal, including zero-open commands in StandUp; thumb2 neutral is unchanged and still physically audited
reach joint upper overrides constrain IK references, never actual simulator joint limits or actual state
ClearHands starts from fresh measured MCP and clears the reference integrator, never resets physical state
only explicit palm-only IK misses may use fallback; foot or COM constraint failures stop rather than silently accepting infeasible references
final crouch_hold keeps ordinary physical PD/gravity/balance control and original force caps; it holds references, never actual joints or free base
profile_snapshot.diagnostic_scope: Fresh original scene, approach then one Touch/Push/Retreat/SettleRelease/Hold; no walking needed when no later push remains. Unchanged D not shortened, no full witness credit; full3cycle still required.
